title: Website Content Platform — Blog, Forum, Slide Channels
phase: Second-Pass Depth Closure — P2 Supporting Domains

key_findings.blog_post_model: blog.post inherits website.published.multi.mixin (is_published field), website.seo.metadata (og: tags). website_id is a related stored field via blog_id.website_id — not a direct FK on the post. visits is readonly integer (no direct increment — read-only). tag_ids is Many2many to blog.tag.
key_findings.blog_seo: _default_website_meta sets og:type=article, article:published_time, article:modified_time, article:tag from tag_ids.mapped('name'). Access to unpublished posts is gated by website.group_website_designer group; public visitors only see posts where post_date <= now.
key_findings.forum_post_states: forum.post.state has 5 values: active, pending, close, offensive, flagged. A post below karma_post (default 100) is auto-set to pending on create. Moderators (karma >= karma_moderate=1000) can validate, refuse, or mark offensive. Marking offensive sets active=False.
key_findings.forum_karma_system: Karma is generated on events: question asked (+2), question upvoted (+5/-2), answer upvoted (+10/-2), answer accepted (+15 to answerer, +2 to acceptor), flagged as spam/offensive (-100, x10 for first posts). Action thresholds are per-forum configurable fields with documented defaults. can_ask/can_edit/can_close etc. are computed fields comparing user.karma to forum thresholds.
key_findings.forum_vote_model: forum.post.vote has unique constraint (post_id, user_id). Vote values: 1, -1, 0. Non-admin cannot forge vote owner. Voting for own post raises UserError. Toggling a -1 vote allows upvoting without meeting upvote karma threshold (and vice versa).
key_findings.slide_channel_model: slide.channel (description='Course') has channel_type (training/documentation), visibility (public/connected/members/link), enroll (public/invite). DB constraint enforces: visibility=members requires enroll=invite. is_visible is computed per user context.
key_findings.slide_access_control: can_publish requires can_upload AND (user is channel responsible OR slides_manager group). channel_type=documentation disables allow_comment by default. slide.is_preview=True allows public access to an individual slide bypassing enrollment.
key_findings.slide_completion_certification: slide.channel.partner tracks member_status: invited/joined/ongoing/completed. Completing the course awards karma_gen_channel_finish=10 karma. Quiz slides award karma that degrades with each attempt: first=10, second=7, third=5, subsequent=2. No built-in certificate PDF model found in base website_slides Community module.

open_questions: No certificate/PDF generation model found in website_slides Community; certification may require website_slides_survey integration.
blog.post.visits field is readonly — the increment mechanism was not traced in this unit; likely done via HTTP controller using sql.increment_fields_skiplock pattern (same as forum.post.views).
forum.forum.privacy field (public/connected/private + authorized_group_id) provides forum-level access control beyond karma; not deeply traced here.
